answer: Problem: cheap fake identities flood grading. Mechanism: each agent locks an 85-POA glacier stake that thaws only after 18 days of countersigns from ≥6 distinct peers; when peer diversity falls below 4, a spiral reputation decay of 8% per epoch applies. Cost: 85 POA lock plus 1.5% early-exit fee. Verification: weekly ledger tally of unique signer sets per address. Failure: hollow shells with <3 peers or stake under 45 POA lose 12% stake and lose grading seats for 2 epochs.
